headline: DMCI Holdings 9-Month Profit Jumps 28% on Subsidiary Contributions
summary: DMCI Holdings Inc. reported a 28% increase in net profit to 15 billion pesos for the first nine months, bolstered by improved earnings contributions across all subsidiaries.
why: Conglomerate earnings reports highlight diversified operational strength across construction, mining, real estate, and power sectors.

impacts.name: DMCI Holdings, Inc.
impacts.why: Stronger earnings contributions from operating subsidiaries directly drive group net profit growth.
